LESSON: SLOPES AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.3: Slopes as simple machines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Slopes as simple machines
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are slopes used in everyday life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify types of slopes used as simple machines
2. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life
3. appreciate the use of slopes in everyday life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Slopes as simple machines

Teach
• Observe Slopes as simple machines in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Slopes as simple machines (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Slopes as simple machines.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Slopes as simple machines.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Slopes as simple machines.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify types of slopes used as simple machines
• demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life
• appreciate the use of slopes in everyday life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Slopes as simple machines.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Slopes as simple machines: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are slopes used in everyday life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• appreciate the use of slopes in everyday life
